intro: Secret Rule: each team has a secret rule about how your group appears in a photo. Take photos as experiments, the AI only says 'holds' or 'does not hold', and you guess the rule.
warmup: Warm-up: pose with your team so the AI would say 'holds' for the rule 'everyone stands on one leg'. Guess what the neighbours made up.

fallback.reason: Round {n}: AI failure during the experiments; fixed practice points

efficient.reason: Round {n}: rule guessed in only {used} experiments
vote.reason: Round {n}: {votes} vote(s) from other teams for the cleverest experiment
finale.title: Finale: one rule for all teams, experimenting in turns
finale.contribution: Finale: did the experiment in lap {lap}

finale.fallback: Finale: AI failure; fixed points for all teams
